== English Decipher comparison ==
Decipher limits deployment to your alien warrior, specifies a character target, and compares against defense value. Tatooine free deployment and the duration of the forfeit penalty remain.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=92 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 92. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 17. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=17 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=16 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 16. Players Committee, 2023, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=122 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A], PDF page 122.
